- **One guess:** Tobias said this was "his dealer account" and didn't name Marrow Fieldworks. A team note from January says Fieldworks, then Pree's dealer account, changed hands on 5 Jan but doesn't say who took it over. So it's most likely Fieldworks, but nothing I can see says so outright.
- **Easy mix-up:** #88412 is a different ticket, for the Tansleigh Packaging Door 6 scanner.

I can't see the ticket itself, so I don't know its current status. I told Pree to check with Tobias or support if she needs the latest before the call.
